subtitle: Revoking stale access, then proving it worked

code:
# Azure: remove a direct Entra ID app role assignment
Remove-MgUserAppRoleAssignment \
  -UserId <userId> -AppRoleAssignmentId <assignmentId>

# AWS: detach a policy attached straight to a user
aws iam detach-user-policy \
  --user-name <username> \
  --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::<account-id>:policy/OTSCADAAdminAccess
caption: Each removal ticketed, reviewed, and run in a scheduled window
